Hallo 👋🏻.

I am currently a PhD student at Yale Linguistics, with a focus on syntax and an occasional interest in syntax's interfaces with semantics and phonology.
Topics that I have looked into or been thinkg about include negation, reduplication and comparative. Languagewise, I am interested in Chinese langauges and Koreanic languages.
I am also curious about the meaning of mathematics and the meaning of programming languages.
